mapper.select: select * FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base where order_id = #{orderId} and is_delivery = '1'

select og.goods_name, og.order_goods_num, og.goods_price, og.order_goods_payment_amount, ob.payment_name, og.order_spec_chineseValue FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob on og.order_id = ob.order_id
and og.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT pickup_num FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base WHERE delivery_time>#{orderCreateTime} AND distributor_id>0 ORDER BY delivery_time DESC LIMIT 1,1
mapper.update: update `mall-rider`.rider_base SET total_price=total_price+#{totalPrice},total_num = total_num + 1,profit = profit + #{totalPrice} WHERE rider_id=#{userId}
